record_title: A sharp reciprocal critical-point diameter bound for collinear zeros
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Tang--Zhang (2025) was inspected in full and does not state this lower bound. Full texts of Pereira (2003) and arXiv:2411.07105 were not inspected here; accessible descriptions provide relevant majorization/one-sided prior art but not the mixed-sign diameter theorem. No independent validation is asserted.
